text:
Maria Gonzalez: FYI — BluePeak Systems just sent over their A100-lite boards for our joint perf/W sweep. want to align on acceptance criteria and what we can publish.
Hao Li: Nice. Do we have a baseline profile for our default gen config? (seq=1024, temp=0.7)
Jess Carter: baseline we usually run: model=redwood-base-v2, batch=1..8, seq=128/512/1024, kv-cache enabled. capture p50/p95, throughput (tokens/s), and wall power (W).
Oliver Reid: For kernel tuning we should test with and without the BluePeak microkernel patch (they provided a patch diff). plan: stock->patch->quantized variants.
Maria Gonzalez: Good. Two questions: 1) embargo window for publishable numbers? 2) telemetry schema — what metrics do we need to hand back to them?
Samir Patel: Legal said embargo must be 10 business days after we hand final numbers, unless we want co-announcement. Sales wants a co-announcement synced with marketplace listing.
Aliya Khan: Telemetry: p50/p90/p95 latency, tokens/s, average power (W), peak power, util% GPU, free_mem_mb, kernel-version, commit-hash, firmware-rev. Also raw logs and perf profiles for repro.
Hao Li: We should also capture energy per token (J/token) and perf-per-watt (tokens/s/W). add that to the schema.
Jess Carter: Agreed. Also include sequence-length distribution for traces; some partners tune kernels for long prefix cases.
Maria Gonzalez: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- throughput improvement >= 8% (patch vs stock) at seq=512 or no regression >3% at seq=128
- perf/W uplift >= 5% at peak operating point
- p95 latency below 350ms for batch=1 seq=128
- stable across 3 runs (stddev throughput < 4%)
If any criterion fails, escalate to eng-runtime for root cause.
Oliver Reid: Sounds reasonable. For the kernel test harness, I'll push a small wrapper that automates both runs and calculates deltas. example invocation:
```bash
./bench_run.sh --model redwood-base-v2 --board bluepeak-a100-lite --seq 512 --batch 4 --runs 3 --collect-power
```
BenchBot: bench_run scheduled: 1733333000. Results will be uploaded to /bench/bluepeak/1733332468/ when complete. :robot_face:
Samir Patel: Who's owning publication text? marketing or partner comms? need to align quotes and logos.
Maria Gonzalez: Partner comms (Jess + Samir) draft a co-announcement only if numbers are A) >8% and B) cleared with legal. Otherwise just joint technical note for partner portal.
Aliya Khan: One more operational note: BluePeak uses a different power sensor (IPMI v2 with custom mapping). I'll add a conversion step in telemetry to normalize to our watts metric.
Hao Li: Should we include a canary run on our Dedicated infra to ensure comparability? sometimes noisy colocation changes watt measurements.
Jess Carter: Yes — schedule a dedicated-node run (pinned) at the same time as partner board to minimize variance. sync clocks and mark run ids.
Maria Gonzalez: Timeline proposal:
- this week: kernel patch smoke + telemetry mapping (Oliver/Aliya)
- next Mon/Tue: full sweep runs (Hao/Jess)
- Wed: results review (all)
- Thu: legal + partner comms sign-off
- Fri: optional co-announcement go/no-go
Can everyone ack?
Hao Li: ack.
Jess Carter: ack. prepping bench configs now.
Oliver Reid: ack. will have harness by EOD.
Aliya Khan: ack. adding conversion layer.
Samir Patel: ack. prepping draft comms (will ping for quotes).
BenchBot: note: live-run telemetry keys -> [p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_per_s,avg_watts,peak_watts,energy_per_token_j]. artifacts: bench_summary.json, profile.tar.gz
Maria Gonzalez: tiny gotcha — BluePeak asked for an embargoed brief to their execs 48h before public. that fits the 10 day window but we need to send a clean deck if numbers look good. Jess, Samir can you own that?
Jess Carter: yep, I'll assemble a deck skeleton and drop it in the partner drive. Samir can add the GTM bullet points.
Samir Patel: yep. Also capture a short quote from eng-runtime on the tuning impact. Oliver?
Oliver Reid: I'll write a 2-sentence technical quote about microkernel lowering context-switch overhead and improving async compaction.
Hao Li: One more: include the exact git commit + compiler flags in the bench_summary so results are reproducible.
Maria Gonzalez: Perfect. I'll send a follow-up checklist and ping Legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jess Carter: small note — if patch requires new firmware from BluePeak, that might push timeline. tagging @BluePeak (external) in partner thread so they can confirm firmware status.
BenchBot: reminder scheduled: run 1733333000 will start in ~7m.
